title: Python Studio dark IDE rebuild
summary: Rebuilt the workspace around a compact IDE shell, CodeMirror file tab, execution toolbar, console, exercises and responsive settings.

changes.detail: Shared charcoal/forest IDE styling, local SVG icons, overflow actions, file dirty state, console empty state, exercise progress, offline indicator and browser integration checks.
Preserved CodeMirror and isolated PythonSession; rebuilt panels with one workspace vertical scroller, desktop settings sidebar, keyboard viewport adaptation, safe areas and reduced motion.
Added missing RTL state to the mobile bridge and made long-line wrapping optional while keeping code and filenames LTR.
Removed duplicate Python header and always-visible secondary controls; retained their functions in overflow and collapsible sections.

validation.name: Initial typecheck and focused lint
validation.detail: Initial pass completed; final implementation checks pending.

validation.name: Browser and full test validation
validation.detail: Pending rebuilt mobile bundle, viewport screenshots, execution smoke tests and full suite.
